messages:
sam: Heads-up: deploybot blocked canary for release/2026.03.21 — missing SBOM provenance + vuln scan flagged CVE-2025-3387 (libpq) as medium-high. Need quick decision: pin & continue, partial regional canary, or full rollback? @maria @jess @qa

deploybot: [automated] release/2026.03.21 canary blocked
reason: sbom.provenance: missing-signature
scan: vuln: CVE-2025-3387 severity 7.2 (libpq) — transitive
affected: image:redwood/runtime:2026.03.21-canary
links: https://deploybot.internal/scans/1769123456

jess: can you paste the deploybot output lines? also which tests failed in canary?

sam: pasted below
```
deploybot: sbom.provenance: missing-signature
vuln: CVE-2025-3387 libpq 7.2 - transitive via pgclient 0.9.2
canary hosts: eu1/us-west/us-east (started 11:12 UTC)
canary success rate: 98.6% (errors: 14/1000)
p50 latency change +15ms
```

maria: tagging in sec. CVE looks moderate 7.2 but exploitability unknown. Two proposals:
- Option A: Pin to previous image (2026.02.28) and continue full rollout after regression tests — safe but delays.
- Option B: Allow a limited US-only canary for 1h with increased monitoring + evidence window (collect syscall logs) — requires S2 approval and release notes update.
If we allow, require: pin on failure, rollback if error rate >2% or 20% increase in p50, and remove EU rollout.

qa: what are the failing test signatures? any integration flakes? We saw 3 flaky db timeouts in eu hosts.

anna: product prefers minimal delay. Can we US-only carveout? ok if security signs.

jess: ops: can we do regional carveout? what's deployment command?

ops: yes. Command:
```
./deploy --image redwood/runtime:2026.03.21-canary --regions us-east,us-west --stagger 10% --monitoring-on
```
also we can pin by using --image redwood/runtime:2026.02.28-stable

maria: i'd approve Option B (US-only 1h with monitoring) under conditions:
- SRE on-call paged
- Collect evidence artifacts: sbom attach, kernel logs, vuln exploit search
- Rollback criteria: error rate >=2% for 15m window OR sustained p50 increase >=100ms
- If any confirmed exploitability => immediate rollback + hotpatch eval

sam: ok let's do that. jess, please run the regional deploy and update release notes: add note "canary limited to US due to provenance flag; monitoring & rollback criteria in place."

jess: running now, pinging after deploy. @deploybot please proceed with regional carveout.

deploybot: proceeding with regional deployment to us-east,us-west at 10% stagger. will report back.

qa: monitoring dashboard link? deploybot? need to watch DB timeouts.

deploybot: dashboard: https://metrics.internal/d/abc123/canary-1769123456

maria: I'll stay on the thread for 1h. if anything odd tag @maria-sec on incidents.

sam: thanks all. decision logged in release notes and change window extended by +1h for evidence collection.
